text: DRREDDY rose 0.87% since the open to 1318.2, inside the 50% 1-day band. The benchmark moved 0.19%, leaving a 0.78% residual; the pharma index rose 1.86%, so the move lines up with the sector. Open trade: up 7% since entry at 1232.0, above its 80% range at N+5. No news candidate.

HDFCBANK slipped 0.34% since the open to 687.05, inside the 50% 1-day band. The benchmark rose 0.19% and the bank index barely moved, so the move is mostly the residual of -0.57%. No news candidate. Open trade: down 6.32% since entry, below its 80% range at N+5.

HINDUNILVR fell 2.22% since the open to 1768.4, below the 50% 1-day band but inside the 80% one. The benchmark rose 0.19% and peers fell 0.73%, leaving a residual of -2.37%. No candidate explains most of it. Open trade: down 6.19% since entry, below its 80% range at N+5.
